basic_info.description: Renovated view townhome in the heart of the Castro. Tri level townhome with floor to ceiling windows and an exclusive view deck. Eureka Gardens offers a truly rare San Francisco living experience with a private 2 car garage with direct access to the home. 2 generous bedrooms with ensuite baths and a third bedroom/office/media room with ensuite bath. The renovated kitchen features SS appliances, gorgeous cabinetry, a designer backsplash, and an oversized SS sink. The top level features  a office nook and direct access to the roof deck. Theres plenty of room seating, dining, plants, and a BBQ. This rare offering is walking distance to Corona Heights park, dining, nightlife, and just a few short blocks from the Castro Station muni line.
